semiconductor_relevance: High — MeetFuture Technology is a leading provider of Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) specifically designed for semiconductor wafer fabs.
summary: MeetFuture Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. specializes in providing comprehensive Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. The company has developed a range of products including Overhead Hoist Transport systems and Stockers, which are deployed in wafer fabs globally, enhancing operational efficiency and reliability.
capabilities: Proprietary software systems for AMHS efficiency

regional_presence.China: The company holds over 70% of the domestic localization market for OHT systems, reflecting strong adoption by top-tier customers.
